name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 10 - Am 66
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 10 a. Considers that the 2026 Budget should prioritise the urgent social needs of European citizens instead of subsidising the excessive profits, dividends and share buybacks of arms multinationals;
